assumptions: 90% source reduction, frozen seven-year economic assumptions.
Age objectives weight actual allocated residents in that age band, with no medical-risk multipliers.
Seasonal weather uses all 2023 hours with constant annual gas-rate proxy; not held-out testing.
limitations: Relative screening index, not concentration, health impact or the separate transport replay.
Uniform within-tract population allocation; no exact home locations.
All retained tract residents are population context, not an affected-resident count.
Scenario ranges are not probabilities or confidence intervals.
robust_objective: Maximize minimum seasonal fraction of baseline weighted index removed, under budget and >=95% annual Financial reference NPV. Seasons are distinct explicit weather slices, not probabilistic draws.
